# discord_guild (Data Source)

Reads a Discord guild (server) by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_guild" "example" {
  id = "123456789012345678"
}

output "guild_name" {
  value = data.discord_guild.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The snowflake ID of the guild to read.

### Read-Only

- `afk_channel_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the AFK channel.
- `afk_timeout` (Number) AFK timeout in seconds.
- `banner` (String) The guild banner hash.
- `default_message_notifications` (Number) Default message notification level.
- `description` (String) The guild description.
- `explicit_content_filter` (Number) Explicit content filter level.
- `icon` (String) The guild icon hash.
- `name` (String) The guild name.
- `owner_id` (String) Snowflake ID of the guild owner.
- `preferred_locale` (String) Preferred locale of a community guild.
- `premium_subscription_count` (Number) Number of boosts the guild has.
- `premium_tier` (Number) Server boost (premium) tier.
- `splash` (String) The guild splash hash.
- `verification_level` (Number) Verification level required for the guild.
